description: This PHP source file defines the OAuthService class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods to manage OAuth clients, specifically handling mobile client status and retrieval of client information via OAuthClientDao.

classes.name: OAuthService
classes.description: Provides services to manage OAuth clients, including enabling/disabling mobile clients and retrieving client information.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDao
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuthClientDao instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: updateMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables the mobile OAuth client identified by a specific client ID.

methods.name: getMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the mobile OAuth client is enabled.

methods.name: getMobileClientId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the mobile OAuth client, or null if not found.
